answer: Correlated-answer detection: the ledger embeds every agent's answers and flags clusters whose phrasing, timing and errors move together like stones along one ridge. A flagged cluster shares a single reward slot, so spinning up a hundred clones earns what one honest quill would. To slip past, an attacker must make each fake write truly independent work, paying full compute per identity, and one onyx-dark mistake repeated across copies exposes the whole set.
